survey: A three-light brass candelabra seen from the front, turned slightly to one side and from a little above. A round, stepped foot sits at the bottom. A turned stem with two knops rises from it. At a collar about halfway up, two U-shaped arms branch out, one to each side. They curve up into candle cups with flat drip pans. The stem goes on past the collar to a taller central cup with its own drip pan. Each cup holds one white candle, seated inside it: the centre candle is the tallest and the two side candles are a little shorter. Each candle has a visible wick, one teardrop flame and a few wax drips running down from the rim. The arms come out of the collar on both sides and look like mirror images; the small differences in reach and height come from the slight turn. The wide foot is centred under the stem, so the piece would stand. The card background is plain, with no table surface, so there is no contact point to check.
